summary: Tested platform branding feature - backend API and frontend UI both working correctly. All 11 backend tests pass. Frontend branding settings page in Network Admin shows all controls (platform name, logo type, favicon, login layout, image type, background images). Login page uses branding settings dynamically. Site type badges show 'Tasks' instead of 'Clara Tasks'.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Branding feature fully implemented. GET /api/branding is public (no auth), PUT /api/branding requires admin. File uploads at /api/branding/upload-logo, /api/branding/upload-favicon, /api/branding/upload-login-image require admin. BrandingProvider wraps app, useBranding() hook provides branding data. BrandLogo/BrandName components render dynamic brand. Login page uses layout (left/right/fullscreen) and image type (static/carousel). Site type badges show 'Tasks' not 'Clara Tasks'.
